sessions.title: Psalm Themes
sessions.theme: Identify major themes in short Psalm excerpts.

rounds.title: Psalm 1:1-3
rounds.excerpt: Blessed is the man... he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 1 contrasts the blessed way with the way of the ungodly.

rounds.title: Psalm 8:1-4
rounds.excerpt: O Lord our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 8 praises God's majesty and mindful care.

rounds.title: Psalm 19:1
rounds.excerpt: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
rounds.teachingNote: Creation witnesses to God's glory.

rounds.title: Psalm 19:7
rounds.excerpt: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul.
rounds.teachingNote: The Psalm turns from creation to the perfection of God's word.

rounds.title: Psalm 23:1-4
rounds.excerpt: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
rounds.teachingNote: The Lord is pictured as shepherd, provider, and guide.

rounds.title: Psalm 24:1
rounds.excerpt: The earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.
rounds.teachingNote: The Psalm announces the Lord's ownership over creation.

rounds.title: Psalm 27:1
rounds.excerpt: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
rounds.teachingNote: The Lord's salvation becomes the ground of confidence.

rounds.title: Psalm 32:1
rounds.excerpt: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
rounds.teachingNote: Forgiveness is the blessing at the center of the Psalm.

rounds.title: Psalm 34:1
rounds.excerpt: I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
rounds.teachingNote: The speaker commits to constant praise.

rounds.title: Psalm 34:8
rounds.excerpt: O taste and see that the Lord is good.
rounds.teachingNote: The excerpt invites trust in God's goodness.

rounds.title: Psalm 42:1
rounds.excerpt: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
rounds.teachingNote: The Psalm gives voice to deep longing for God.

rounds.title: Psalm 46:1
rounds.excerpt: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
rounds.teachingNote: God is confessed as refuge in trouble.

rounds.title: Psalm 51:10
rounds.excerpt: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
rounds.teachingNote: The prayer asks for cleansing and renewal.

rounds.title: Psalm 63:1
rounds.excerpt: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee.
rounds.teachingNote: The Psalm expresses earnest seeking after God.

rounds.title: Psalm 91:1-2
rounds.excerpt: He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
rounds.teachingNote: The Psalm centers on shelter and trust.

rounds.title: Psalm 95:1-2
rounds.excerpt: O come, let us sing unto the Lord: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
rounds.teachingNote: The excerpt calls God's people to worship.

rounds.title: Psalm 100:1-4
rounds.excerpt: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise.
rounds.teachingNote: Thanksgiving marks the approach to worship.

rounds.title: Psalm 103:1-2
rounds.excerpt: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits.
rounds.teachingNote: The Psalm calls the soul to remember and bless the Lord.

rounds.title: Psalm 107:1
rounds.excerpt: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
rounds.teachingNote: The verse gives thanks for enduring mercy.

rounds.title: Psalm 118:24
rounds.excerpt: This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
rounds.teachingNote: The day the Lord has made becomes a call to rejoice.

rounds.title: Psalm 119:11
rounds.excerpt: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
rounds.teachingNote: God's word is treasured in the heart.

rounds.title: Psalm 119:105
rounds.excerpt: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
rounds.teachingNote: The word is pictured as guidance.

rounds.title: Psalm 121:1-2
rounds.excerpt: My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.
rounds.teachingNote: Help comes from the maker of heaven and earth.

rounds.title: Psalm 139:14
rounds.excerpt: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
rounds.teachingNote: Human life is received as God's wonderful work.

rounds.title: Psalm 150:6
rounds.excerpt: Let every thing that hath breath praise the Lord.
rounds.teachingNote: The Psalter closes with a universal call to praise.
